-- | Cac kieu du lieu cot loi cua game (chi la du lieu, chua co luat choi).

module Game.Types

-- | Toa do tren map. <tt>posX</tt> tang sang phai, <tt>posY</tt> tang
--   xuong duoi.
data Pos
Pos :: Int -> Int -> Pos
[posX] :: Pos -> Int
[posY] :: Pos -> Int

-- | Bon huong di chuyen. <a>DirUp</a> lam giam <tt>posY</tt> di 1.
data Direction
DirUp :: Direction
DirDown :: Direction
DirLeft :: Direction
DirRight :: Direction

-- | Tam huong (8 phia) dung cho ket qua scan. <a>Here</a> nghia la cung o.
data Compass
North :: Compass
NorthEast :: Compass
East :: Compass
SouthEast :: Compass
South :: Compass
SouthWest :: Compass
West :: Compass
NorthWest :: Compass
Here :: Compass

-- | Nam loai tai nguyen.
data ResourceType
Iron :: ResourceType
Crystal :: ResourceType
EnergyCore :: ResourceType
RareOre :: ResourceType
ExoticMatter :: ResourceType

-- | So luong tung loai tai nguyen (loai khong co trong bang nghia la 0).
type Resources = Map ResourceType Int

-- | Ba loai hanh tinh cua ban MVP.
data PlanetType
Mining :: PlanetType
Energy :: PlanetType
Rare :: PlanetType

-- | Ma so cua hanh tinh (1, 2, 3, ...).
type PlanetId = Int

-- | Mot hanh tinh. <a>planetStock</a> la ton kho con lai, dung chung cho
--   hai nguoi.
data Planet
Planet :: PlanetId -> Pos -> PlanetType -> Resources -> Planet
[planetId] :: Planet -> PlanetId
[planetPos] :: Planet -> Pos
[planetType] :: Planet -> PlanetType
[planetStock] :: Planet -> Resources

-- | Thong tin ve mot hanh tinh ma nguoi choi da kham pha (vi tri va loai).
data KnownPlanet
KnownPlanet :: Pos -> PlanetType -> KnownPlanet
[knownPos] :: KnownPlanet -> Pos
[knownType] :: KnownPlanet -> PlanetType

-- | Hai nguoi choi.
data PlayerId
Player1 :: PlayerId
Player2 :: PlayerId

-- | Trang thai cua mot nguoi choi.
data Player
Player :: Pos -> Int -> Int -> Resources -> Resources -> Map PlanetId KnownPlanet -> Player
[playerPos] :: Player -> Pos
[playerBattery] :: Player -> Int
[playerAP] :: Player -> Int

-- | kho tren tau
[playerCargo] :: Player -> Resources

-- | kho rieng tai Earth
[playerStorage] :: Player -> Resources

-- | hanh tinh da kham pha
[playerKnown] :: Player -> Map PlanetId KnownPlanet

-- | Ly do thang.
data WinReason

-- | du diem o kho Earth
ReachedTarget :: WinReason

-- | doi thu het battery
OpponentOutOfBattery :: WinReason

-- | doi thu mat ket noi
OpponentDisconnected :: WinReason

-- | het so vong, diem Earth cao hon
HigherScoreAtLimit :: WinReason

-- | Ket qua cua mot tran.
data GameResult
Winner :: PlayerId -> WinReason -> GameResult
Draw :: GameResult

-- | Giai doan cua tran dau.
data GamePhase
WaitingForPlayers :: GamePhase
InProgress :: GamePhase
Finished :: GameResult -> GamePhase

-- | Toan bo trang thai cua mot tran. Server giu ban day du nay.
data GameState
GameState :: Int -> Int -> Pos -> Map PlanetId Planet -> Player -> Player -> PlayerId -> Int -> GamePhase -> StdGen -> GameState
[gsMapWidth] :: GameState -> Int
[gsMapHeight] :: GameState -> Int
[gsEarth] :: GameState -> Pos
[gsPlanets] :: GameState -> Map PlanetId Planet
[gsPlayer1] :: GameState -> Player
[gsPlayer2] :: GameState -> Player

-- | nguoi dang co luot
[gsCurrent] :: GameState -> PlayerId

-- | vong hien tai (1 vong = luot P1 roi luot P2)
[gsRound] :: GameState -> Int
[gsPhase] :: GameState -> GamePhase

-- | bo sinh so ngau nhien
[gsRng] :: GameState -> StdGen
data Action
Move :: Direction -> Action
Observe :: Action
ScanArea :: Action
ScanNearest :: Action
ScanOpponent :: Action
Mine :: ResourceType -> Action
Deposit :: Action

-- | loai tai nguyen va so luong dung de nap
Recharge :: ResourceType -> Int -> Action
EndTurn :: Action

-- | Ly do mot action bi tu choi (khi bi tu choi thi khong mat gi).
data GameError

-- | tran chua bat dau hoac da ket thuc
GameNotInProgress :: GameError
NotYourTurn :: GameError
NotEnoughAP :: GameError
NotEnoughBattery :: GameError

-- | di ra ngoai map
OutOfBounds :: GameError

-- | Mine khi khong dung tren hanh tinh
NotOnPlanet :: GameError

-- | hanh tinh khong con loai tai nguyen do
PlanetHasNoSuchResource :: GameError
CargoFull :: GameError

-- | Deposit khi cargo rong
CargoEmpty :: GameError

-- | Recharge khi khong dung o Earth
NotAtEarth :: GameError

-- | Deposit khi qua xa Earth
OutOfDepositRange :: GameError

-- | Recharge khi battery da day
BatteryFull :: GameError

-- | kho Earth khong du tai nguyen de nap
NotEnoughResources :: GameError

-- | so luong khong hop le (&lt;= 0)
InvalidAmount :: GameError

-- | Thong bao gui cho doi thu khi ban lam mot action.
data Notice
YouWereScanned :: Notice

-- | Ket qua rieng cua tung action danh cho nguoi hanh dong.
data ActionResult
Moved :: Pos -> ActionResult
PlanetsFound :: [KnownPlanet] -> ActionResult

-- | huong va khoang cach, hoac khong con hanh tinh
NearestPlanet :: Maybe (Compass, Int) -> ActionResult
OpponentDirection :: Compass -> ActionResult
Mined :: ResourceType -> Int -> ActionResult
Deposited :: Resources -> ActionResult

-- | so battery thuc su nhan duoc
Recharged :: Int -> ActionResult
TurnEnded :: ActionResult

-- | Bao cao cua mot action thanh cong.
data ActionReport
ActionReport :: ActionResult -> Maybe Notice -> ActionReport
[reportResult] :: ActionReport -> ActionResult

-- | thong bao cho doi thu, neu co
[reportNotice] :: ActionReport -> Maybe Notice

-- | Ham tien ich de doc va cap nhat <a>GameState</a> va tai nguyen.
module Game.State

-- | Lay nguoi choi theo <a>PlayerId</a>.
getPlayer :: PlayerId -> GameState -> Player

-- | Thay nguoi choi bang mot ban moi.
setPlayer :: PlayerId -> Player -> GameState -> GameState

-- | Ap dung mot ham len nguoi choi.
modifyPlayer :: PlayerId -> (Player -> Player) -> GameState -> GameState

-- | Nguoi choi con lai.
otherPlayer :: PlayerId -> PlayerId

-- | Hanh tinh dang nam tai mot o (neu co).
planetAt :: Pos -> GameState -> Maybe Planet

-- | Cong hai kho tai nguyen.
addResources :: Resources -> Resources -> Resources

-- | Tru tai nguyen. Tra ve <a>Nothing</a> neu kho khong du bat ky loai
--   nao. Ket qua khong chua loai co so luong 0.
removeResources :: Resources -> Resources -> Maybe Resources

-- | Tong so don vi tai nguyen.
totalUnits :: Resources -> Int

-- | Tong diem cua mot kho tai nguyen.
resourcesValue :: Config -> Resources -> Int

-- | Diem cua nguoi choi (chi tinh kho Earth, khong tinh cargo).
playerScore :: Config -> Player -> Int


-- | Chieu <a>GameState</a> thanh phan ma mot nguoi choi duoc phep biet.
--   
--   Server giu <a>GameState</a> day du, nhung chi gui <a>PlayerView</a>
--   cho tung nguoi. Trong luc choi, <a>PlayerView</a> khong chua vi tri,
--   kho hay diem cua doi thu, khong chua hanh tinh chua kham pha. Khi tran
--   ket thuc, <a>summaryOf</a> tao ban tong ket lo diem va vi tri cuoi cua
--   ca hai ben.
module Game.View

-- | Nhung gi mot nguoi choi duoc thay.
data PlayerView
PlayerView :: PlayerId -> Int -> Int -> Pos -> Int -> Int -> PlayerId -> GamePhase -> Pos -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Resources -> Int -> Resources -> Int -> Int -> Map PlanetId KnownPlanet -> Maybe Planet -> PlayerView
[viewSelf] :: PlayerView -> PlayerId

[viewMapHeight] :: PlayerView -> Int

-- | chi diem cua chinh nguoi choi
[viewScore] :: PlayerView -> Int
[viewScoreTarget] :: PlayerView -> Int
[viewKnown] :: PlayerView -> Map PlanetId KnownPlanet

-- | hanh tinh dang dung tren (kem ton kho)
[viewHere] :: PlayerView -> Maybe Planet

-- | Thong tin cuoi cung cua mot nguoi choi, lo ra khi tran ket thuc.
data PlayerFinal
PlayerFinal :: Pos -> Int -> PlayerFinal
[finalPos] :: PlayerFinal -> Pos
[finalScore] :: PlayerFinal -> Int

-- | Ban tong ket cua hai nguoi choi khi tran ket thuc.
data GameSummary
GameSummary :: PlayerFinal -> PlayerFinal -> GameSummary
[summaryPlayer1] :: GameSummary -> PlayerFinal
[summaryPlayer2] :: GameSummary -> PlayerFinal

-- | Phan trang thai ma nguoi choi nay duoc thay.
viewFor :: Config -> PlayerId -> GameState -> PlayerView

-- | Ban tong ket: vi tri va diem cuoi cua ca hai nguoi choi.
summaryOf :: Config -> GameState -> GameSummary

-- | Cac ham thuan ve toa do: khoang cach, bien map, huong, di chuyen.
module Game.World

-- | Khoang cach Manhattan giua hai o (bang so buoc phai di).
--   
--   <pre>
--   &gt;&gt;&gt; distance (Pos 0 0) (Pos 3 4)
--   7
--   </pre>
distance :: Pos -> Pos -> Int

-- | O co nam trong map khong (toa do tu 0 den kich thuoc tru 1).
inBounds :: Config -> Pos -> Bool

-- | Moi o cua map.
allCells :: Config -> [Pos]

-- | Di mot buoc theo huong. Ham nay khong kiem tra bien map.
movePos :: Direction -> Pos -> Pos

-- | Huong (8 phia) tu o thu nhat toi o thu hai.
--   
--   Neu doc lech &gt;= 2 lan ngang lech thi chi tinh Bac/Nam (va nguoc lai
--   cho Dong/Tay), con lai la huong cheo. Cung o thi tra ve <a>Here</a>.
compassFrom :: Pos -> Pos -> Compass

-- | O thu hai co nam trong ban kinh (Manhattan) quanh o thu nhat khong.
withinRadius :: Int -> Pos -> Pos -> Bool

-- | Cac o trong map cach o trung tam tu <tt>lo</tt> den <tt>hi</tt> buoc
--   (Manhattan).
ringCells :: Config -> Pos -> Int -> Int -> [Pos]


-- | Sinh map, hanh tinh va vi tri xuat phat tu mot seed ngau nhien.
module Game.Generate

-- | Tao mot tran moi (da du hai nguoi, Player1 di truoc, vong 1). Cung cau
--   hinh va cung seed luon ra cung ket qua.
newGame :: Config -> Int -> GameState

-- | Sinh cac hanh tinh: dung so luong tung loai, o khac nhau, khong nam
--   gan Earth hon <a>cfgPlanetMinEarthDist</a>.
generatePlanets :: Config -> StdGen -> (Map PlanetId Planet, StdGen)

-- | Boc ngau nhien <tt>k</tt> phan tu khac nhau (khong lap) tu danh sach.
--   Neu <tt>k</tt> bang do dai danh sach thi ket qua la mot hoan vi ngau
--   nhien.
pickDistinct :: Int -> [a] -> StdGen -> ([a], StdGen)


-- | Luat cua tung action: kiem tra dieu kien, tru chi phi, cap nhat trang
--   thai.
--   
--   Module nay khong lo chuyen luot hay kiem tra thang/thua (viec cua
--   <a>Game.Turn</a>).
module Game.Action

-- | Thuc hien mot action cho nguoi choi. Khong kiem tra luot (viec cua
--   <a>Game.Turn</a>). Tra ve loi neu khong hop le, hoac trang thai moi va
--   bao cao.
performAction :: Config -> PlayerId -> Action -> GameState -> Either GameError (GameState, ActionReport)


-- | Luot choi: ap dung action cua mot nguoi, doi luot, kiem tra
--   thang/thua.
module Game.Turn

-- | Ap dung mot action cua nguoi choi. Kiem tra tran dang choi va dung
--   luot, roi thuc hien action, roi xu ly ket qua (thang, thua, het AP thi
--   doi luot).
applyAction :: Config -> PlayerId -> Action -> GameState -> Either GameError (GameState, ActionReport)

-- | Ket thuc luot hien tai. Sau luot cua Player2 thi sang vong moi, neu da
--   het so vong thi tinh ket qua theo diem kho Earth. Nguoi den luot duoc
--   nap day AP.
endTurn :: Config -> GameState -> GameState

-- | Nguoi choi mat ket noi thi doi thu thang. Tran da ket thuc thi giu
--   nguyen.
forfeit :: PlayerId -> GameState -> GameState


-- | Module chinh cua package <tt>space-war</tt>.
--   
--   Re-export cac module game (<tt>Game.*</tt>) de cac noi khac chi can
--   <tt>import Lib</tt>.
module Lib

-- | In mot dong chao mau (giu lai tu template cua stack).
someFunc :: IO ()

-- | Ten cua project.
--   
--   Vi du:
--   
--   <pre>
--   &gt;&gt;&gt; projectName
--   "space-war"
--   </pre>
projectName :: String


-- | Cac tin nhan giua client (trinh duyet) va server.
module Protocol.Message

-- | Tin nhan nguoi choi gui len server.
data ClientMsg

-- | xin vao tran
Join :: ClientMsg

-- | lam mot action
DoAction :: Action -> ClientMsg

-- | Tin nhan server gui xuong nguoi choi.
data ServerMsg

-- | chao mung, cho biet minh la ai
Welcome :: PlayerId -> ServerMsg

-- | dang cho nguoi choi thu hai
WaitingForOpponent :: ServerMsg

-- | tran bat dau
GameStarted :: PlayerView -> ServerMsg

-- | action cua minh duoc chap nhan
ActionAccepted :: ActionReport -> PlayerView -> ServerMsg

-- | action cua minh bi tu choi
ActionRejected :: GameError -> ServerMsg

-- | doi thu vua lam xong, kem thong bao neu co
OpponentActed :: Maybe Notice -> PlayerView -> ServerMsg

-- | tran ket thuc
GameOver :: GameResult -> GameSummary -> ServerMsg

-- | tin nhan gui len bi hong hoac khong hieu
ProtocolError :: String -> ServerMsg
instance GHC.Classes.Eq Protocol.Message.ClientMsg
instance GHC.Classes.Eq Protocol.Message.ServerMsg
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show Protocol.Message.ClientMsg
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show Protocol.Message.ServerMsg


-- | Chuyen cac kieu cua game va cac tin nhan sang JSON (va nguoc lai),
--   viet tay.
--   
--   Cac instance duoc dat o day thay vi trong <a>Game.Types</a> de loi
--   game khong phu thuoc vao JSON (vi vay phai tat canh bao orphan o dau
--   file).
module Protocol.Json

-- | Ma hoa mot tin nhan server thanh chuoi JSON de gui di.
encodeServerMsg :: ServerMsg -> ByteString

--   hong.
decodeClientMsg :: ByteString -> Either String ClientMsg

resourcesToJSON :: Resources -> Value
